acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params.initialOwner: Administrative owner; only used to wire the factory once.
params.positionManager_: The canonical Uniswap V4 PositionManager for this chain.

lockPosition(address,uint256).details: Called once per launch by the factory, immediately after minting the full-range position directly to this locker's address.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.details: Not part of the graduation path. Graduation names this locker as the `MINT_POSITION` owner, and the PositionManager mints with a plain `_mint`, which fires no receiver callback. Custody is established by the `ownerOf` check in `lockPosition` instead. This exists so the locker still behaves correctly under an explicit `safeTransferFrom`, and so such a transfer can only ever originate from the canonical PositionManager.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

isLocked(address).notice: Returns whether a launch's position has been locked here.

lockPosition(address,uint256).notice: Registers and verifies permanent custody of a graduated position.

lockTokenSupply(address,uint256).notice: Permanently locks the virtual-reserve token remainder that cannot enter the graduated pool without lowering its opening price.

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.notice: Rejects safe transfers of anything but a canonical position NFT.

renounceOwnership().notice: Permanently disabled. Ownership here exists only to perform the one-time factory wiring, and renouncing before that wiring would leave the locker unable to ever accept a graduated position.

setFactory(address).notice: One-time wiring of the v2 factory, set after both are deployed.
